title: MagicMod
description: This mod adds a divine sword to Minecraft. It is immune to all damage, can fly, and has abilities like fire, ice, wind, and thunder. At the same time, it is extremely difficult to craft... This is my first mod, mostly featuring AI components. The author is
body:
Super Powerful Magic Sword. 1.20.1 Forge. 0.0.1 Alpha.

Seven abilities:
- Lightning
- Fire
- Frost
- Wind
- Erase
- Invincible
- Flight

Damage? High. Balance? None. Fun? Yes.

First mod. Java learner. Feedback = love.

GitHub link below. MIT.
-------------------------------------------------
